data.title: Trial Grounds
data.summary: Asymmetric horror for Minecraft Bedrock: one killer hunts survivors who repair generators, evade hooks, and escape before the trial claims them.

revisions.changelog:
Trial Grounds 2.0

The biggest update yet: a new map, perks, an AI Killer that uses its Killer's power, an end game with a collapse and a hatch, player stats, and new looks for every Killer.

New map: Veronika Fair

An abandoned fairground built around Vulpine, and the third map in Our Maps.

  • Walk in under a carnival arch with VERONIKA FAIR in lights and Vulpine's face on both sides
  • A giant Vulpine statue stands in the plaza, hook raised and name tag on
  • The big top, Vulpine's Cove (a theatre with a curtained stage), a Ferris wheel, a carousel, a swing ride, bumper cars, game booths, a high striker, a fortune teller's tent and food stands
  • 96×96 · 4 of 6 generators · 7 hooks · 13 pallets

Blackpit Mine

Coal Tower is now Blackpit Mine, rebuilt from top to bottom:

  • Gravel paths, a warehouse with a brick upper storey and a caved-in roof, a winding wheel on the tower, a rusty tank, a timber shed, spruce woods, coal seams and two old mine tunnels
  • A new pallet loop in the open ground between the warehouse, the tank and the shack (11 pallets now), plus fallen logs and woodpiles for cover

Grizzly and Vulpine

The last two Killers get their new models, so all six now share the same style:

  • Grizzly: a withered animatronic bear with the suit torn open to the metal skeleton, red eyes, a jaw full of teeth, his top hat and a vintage mic
  • Vulpine: rust-red fur torn open to the endoskeleton, an eyepatch, one burning amber eye, a steel hook for a hand, and the VERONIKA name tag

Perks

Every player picks one perk for each side: open the Trial Guide and tap Perks.

  • Grease Monkey (Survivor): repair generators 25% faster
  • Cut and Run (Survivor): when the Killer hits you, sprint off with a burst of speed for 3 seconds (once a minute)
  • Slip the Hook (Survivor): once per trial, hold sneak on a hook for 6 seconds to pull yourself free
  • Short Circuit (Killer): every Survivor you hook knocks 15% off the generator closest to done
  • Splinter (Killer): break pallets in half the time, and shake off pallet stuns a second sooner
  • Hush (Killer): Survivors only hear your heartbeat from 16 blocks away instead of 32

The AI Killer

  • Pick Easy, Normal or Hard when you set up a trial against it
  • Its hits work like a player Killer's: the first injures you, the second downs you. It carries you to a hook, and you can struggle free with A/D
  • Walls hide you from it. It hears generators, gates and failed skill checks, and comes to look
  • Pallets stun it, and you hear its heartbeat when it gets close
  • It uses its Killer's power: the Spectrum Blinks at you, Grizzly sings, Vulpine pounces, Strix swoops in with no heartbeat, Corvid's crows find you, and the Butcher follows the blood through walls

The end game

  • The collapse: once the gates have power, survivors have 2 minutes to get out. The clock slows while someone is hooked, downed or carried
  • The hatch: when one survivor is left, a hatch opens somewhere on the grounds. Hold sneak on it to escape. The Killer can slam it shut

Also new

  • Head start: the Killer is held for 12 seconds while the survivors scatter
  • Player stats: results after every trial, and your record under My Stats in the Trial Guide
  • Patch yourself up: with nobody left to heal you, hold sneak away from generators
  • Hooks light up for the Killer while they carry someone, and the HUD points to the nearest free one
  • One set of rules for everyone: during a trial everyone plays in Survival and gets their own game mode back afterwards. There's no real damage or hunger, and the grounds can't be broken or built on

Fixes

  • Sacrificed players were left in Spectator mode after the trial
  • Killer hits did real damage and could kill a survivor outright, the AI Killer's included
  • The AI Killer floated away when you hit it
  • Grizzly's song barely slowed anyone down
  • A pallet pulled up on the Killer in the gap trapped them inside it
  • Setting up another trial on the same map sank generator lamps and hooks into the ground
  • Generator lamps could stand inside the arena fence
  • Blackpit Mine's iron bars and fences stood as loose posts
  • Exit gates could sink into dirt paths

v3.48 last beta


New

  • Corvid now has a power: periodically receives a Crow's Eye — use it to send crows toward the nearest survivor for audio/visual tracking cues.
  • Grizzly now has a power: Sneak + weapon to sing, releasing a stunning wave in front of him.
  • Vulpine now has a power: Sneak + weapon to Pounce, gaining a temporary burst of speed.

Fixed

  • Hooked survivors were landing beside the hook instead of on it — fixed (duplicate hook entity, idle swing animation not stopping, and a hang-position rotation bug).
  • Corvid's model was buggy (floating, missing legs) — fully rebuilt with correct proportions and a new texture.
  • Fixed a duplicate internal model ID that could cause the generator to render incorrectly.
  • Vulpine's Pounce speed boost was being cut short almost immediately — now runs its full duration.
  • Trials no longer get stuck indefinitely if the Killer disconnects.
  • Fixed a leftover-object bug when a survivor disconnects while hooked.

Changed

  • Corvid, Grizzly, and Vulpine now explain how to use their power as soon as you're picked as them.
  • Dev/test commands are now host-only.

data.title: Extensive Mob Heads
data.summary: Adds placeable and wearable mob heads for EVERY vanilla mob in the game.

revisions.changelog:
Additions:


• Added the Head Index, a book that keeps track of which heads have been collected by the player.

• Added custom achievements for collecting various different heads.

• Added all baby variant heads. You can toggle baby mobs dropping their heads in the Head Settings.

• Added new crafting recipe for Tamed Decorated Llama heads, Copper Golem Poppy heads, Iron Golem heads, Snow Golem and Snow Golem Pumpkin heads.

• Villagers are now scared of any Zombie type heads.

• Added Clownfish head.

• Added Tamed Trader Llama heads.

• Added Sulfur Cube heads.

• Added Armored Wither heads.

• Added NPC heads.

 

Gameplay:


• Wrench rotation has changed. You will now be able to rotate heads even when they are placed against a wall or upside down.

• Placing any head on top of a chest will no longer prevent the chest from opening.

• Updated mob note sounds to include the new sounds from the Tiny Takeover update.

• Fixed horse heads not playing their sound when put on a noteblock.

• Changed the way Tamed Wolf Armor heads store their armor durability.

• Updated Rabbit heads.

• Nautilus heads on noteblocks now play different sounds depending on whether they are waterlogged or not.

• Moobloom heads now have a 20% chance of dropping a sunflower when sheared.

• Moobloom heads can now be crafted with sunflowers.

• Slime heads got bouncier.

• Slime heads can now push entities.

• Slime heads no longer force /gamerule falldamage to be true.

• Any Zombie head will now damage surrounding Villagers and Players when worn.

• Warden heads will now detect jumping.

• Wither heads are bigger now, making it accurate to the actual Wither's heads.

• Enderman heads will teleport off of the player's head when it's raining or the player is in water.

• Enderman heads will teleport when they are exposed to rain.

• The Enderdragon head can now shoot its fireball if interacted with a bottle of dragon's breath.

• Collisions for Low Shulker Shell heads have changed.

• Fixed the agent sound playing when any magenta head was put on a noteblock.

• Removed Herobrine head.

 

Visual:


• You can now toggle between using vanilla textures or custom textures in the resource pack settings.

• Added subtitles to all sounds.

• Head particles no longer block your vision.

• Fixed an issue where textures were failing to load for some players.

• Fixed translucent heads not rendering correctly as items.

• Horse heads will now display correctly in the inventory.

• Horse heads with armor display their armor correctly now.

• Squid and Glow Squid heads will now shoot ink when the wearer is taking damage.

• Tropical Fish heads can now have their 6th pattern, which was previously forgotten about.

• Moobloom head is now animated.

• Slime and Magmacube heads now have different item sizes making it easier to tell their sizes apart.

• Warden head is now animated.

• Fixed the sides of Low and High Shulker Shell heads rendering black when next to a block.

• Shells of Shulker Shell heads no longer rotate with its head.

 

Technical:

• Changed min engine version to 1.26.50.

• WAILA support.

data.short_description: Adds placeable and wearable mob heads for EVERY vanilla mob in the game.

data.title: Rustic (Unofficial)
data.summary: Rustic is an addon that adds medieval-themed content in different areas: Agriculture, Production, and Decoration.

revisions.changelog:
Changelog V2.2.5

Blocks

  • Double slabs made from addon materials now drop 2 items instead of 1 when broken.
  • Changed the doors to use the MultiBlock trait.
  • Reduced the evaporation time of items in a drying basin when placed above a magma block.
  • Improved the leaf decay system.
  • Changed the ID of Flowered Apple Leaves. Breaking existing Flowered Apple Leaves before updating is recommended to avoid issues.
  • Updated the textures of Apple Leaves and Flowered Apple Leaves.
  • Updated the textures of Apple Tree Logs and Stripped Apple Tree Logs.
  • Slightly updated the texture of Ironwood Logs.
  • Slightly updated the texture of Ironwood Leaves.
  • Updated the textures of Ironwood Doors and Trapdoors.
  • Updated the textures of Olive Doors and Trapdoors.
  • Updated the textures of Apple Wood Doors and Trapdoors.
  • Apple Leaves, Flowered Apple Leaves, Ironwood Leaves, and Olive Leaves now interact correctly with shears, including breaking time and loot.
  • Flowered Apple Leaves now drop their normal Apple Leaves when broken with shears.
  • Changed the interaction system for Wooden Stakes.
  • Improved interactions with crops grown on Wooden Stakes.
  • Crops grown on Wooden Stakes now use their corresponding sounds.
  • Reduced the breaking time of Rope.
  • Increased the breaking time of Gold Chains.

Items

  • Changed the texture of Ginseng.
  • Changed the texture of Marsh Mallow.
  • Reworked the Chamomile herb.

Gameplay

  • Reduced the chance of obtaining Tomato and Chili seeds when breaking Short Grass and Tall Grass.
  • Reduced the chance of obtaining Grape seeds when breaking Vines.
  • Breaking Short Grass, Tall Grass, and Vines in Creative mode or while using shears will no longer drop seeds.

Upcoming Addon Rebranding

In a future update, Rustic Agriculture will be renamed to simply Rustic.

We want to announce this change in advance so players can begin familiarizing themselves with the new name and prepare for the transition.

The addon has grown far beyond its original focus on agriculture. While farming remains a core part of the experience, Rustic now includes many features that extend into other areas of gameplay.

This rebranding will also allow the project to evolve into a modular ecosystem. Once Rustic reaches a more complete and polished state, additional addons may be released as separate expansions that depend on Rustic to function.

Potential future expansions include:

  • Rustic Agriculture
  • Rustic Carpentry
  • Rustic Cooking
  • And many other themed modules

The goal is to make Rustic the foundation of a larger collection of interconnected addons while allowing each expansion to focus on its own unique theme and gameplay mechanics.

Changelog v2.2.4:

Iron Lattice Rework

  • Iron Lattice now uses the minecraft:connection trait for cardinal connections.
  • Updated the Iron Lattice texture.
  • Iron Lattice can now be decorated with any type of leaves. Simply interact with the lattice while holding leaves to attach them. To remove the leaves, interact with the lattice using an empty hand while sneaking.
  • Updated the Iron Lattice block sound effects.
  • Adjusted the collision box for every possible Iron Lattice state to make collisions as accurate as possible.
  • Adjusted the selection box for every possible Iron Lattice state to improve player interaction.

Note

  • Some internal Iron Lattice IDs have been changed. It is recommended to break and replace existing Iron Lattice blocks after updating.

Slab Rework

  • Reworked all addon slabs to behave exactly like vanilla slabs.

This includes:

  • Creating double slabs from any valid placement interaction.
  • Matching vanilla item display behavior in inventories, first-person view, third-person view, item frames, and shelves.

Some minor adjustments are still needed and will be addressed in future Minecraft updates.

Known Issues

  • Breaking a double slab currently drops only 1 item instead of 2.
  • If a slab is placed in the bottom half of a block and then converted into a double slab, torches cannot be placed on top of it.

Breaking Change

The IDs of four blocks have been changed to better match vanilla naming conventions:

  • Sandstone Brick Stairs
  • Sandstone Brick Slab
  • Red Sandstone Brick Stairs
  • Red Sandstone Brick Slab

If these blocks are already placed in your world, it is recommended to remove and replace them after updating.

Stair Improvements

  • Addon stairs now behave much more similarly to vanilla stairs.

Known Issues

  • UV lock is not correctly applied to stair textures.
  • Addon stairs do not connect to vanilla stairs.

Block Connectivity Improvements

  • A large number of addon blocks now explicitly define whether they should connect to other blocks.
  • Many blocks now use minecraft:support to specify whether support-dependent blocks can be attached to them (for example, placing torches on the sides of a block).
  • Improved trapdoor interactions with fences.

Table Improvements

  • Reduced the breaking time of tables from 2.5 seconds to 2.0 seconds.
  • Wooden tables now use the minecraft:connection trait for cardinal connections. This new system improves table interactions and significantly increases update speed when connecting to adjacent tables.

Note

The use of this trait allows tables to connect to full blocks and fences, which is not intended behavior. After evaluating the advantages and disadvantages, the benefits were found to outweigh the drawbacks.

Benefits include:

  • Instant connections with no delay.
  • Proper updates when moved by pistons.
  • Proper updates when affected by explosions.
  • Additional technical improvements behind the scenes.

As a result, this behavior will remain for the time being.

Caged Redstone Torch

  • Added a crafting recipe for the Caged Redstone Torch.
  • Fixed an issue where the Caged Redstone Torch would power the block it was attached to, creating an unintended redstone clock.

Lantern Improvements

  • Updated the textures of the Iron, Gold, and Copper Lanterns.
  • Adjusted the lantern collision boxes to be as accurate as possible.
  • Updated the lantern selection boxes.
  • Adjusted how lanterns are displayed when held in hand, dropped as items, and placed in item frames.

Plants & Environment

  • All herbs can now be snowlogged.
  • Wildberry Bushes can now be snowlogged.
  • Wildberry Bushes can now be placed in flower pots.
  • Adjusted the selection boxes of several herbs.

Food & Consumables

  • Consuming Cloudsbluff now applies a movement slowdown effect. However, players will still move faster compared to consuming most other foods.
  • Reduced the Cloudsbluff consumption cooldown from 4.0 seconds to 3.8 seconds.

Changelog:

Redesigned the custom effects UI system.

  • Custom effects now appear in order instead of being separated across the UI.
  • Custom effects are now displayed in the lower-left corner of the HUD.
  • Improved compatibility with addons that modify the UI (e.g., WAILA).
  • If you encounter compatibility issues with another addon, it is recommended to prioritize that addon above Rustic in the resource and behavior load order. You can also disable the custom effects UI using the new addon configuration command, which is recommended if any incompatibilities occur.
  • Fixed an issue that would constantly display the title "empty;" on the screen (most commonly caused by addon compatibility issues).

Known Issues

  • If you leave a world while custom effects are active, you may need to move your character after rejoining for the effects to reappear on the screen.

Custom Effects Adjustments

  • Alcoholic beverages must now have a minimum quality of 0.70 to grant positive effects. Qualities between 0.50 and 0.69 are neutral.
    • For Ironberry Wine, qualities between 0.70 and 0.74 grant temporary hearts. Maximum quality (0.75) grants permanent extra hearts until the player dies.
  • Adjusted several effects related to Inebriation:
    • Level III now grants Nausea and Slowness.
    • Level IV amplifies the previous effects and additionally grants Blindness.
  • Reduced the chance of gaining Inebriation from beverages with a quality of 0.70 or higher by 10%.
  • Removed Levels II and III from the Magic Resistance, Wither Ward, and Full Stomach effects.
  • Fixed an issue where consuming Grape Wine would increase the duration of custom effects far more than intended with a single bottle.
  • Fixed an issue that prevented Grape Wine from extending the duration of custom effects that were Level II or higher.
  • Now, when you get alcoholic beverages from the Creative menu, they will have a base quality of 0.75 indicated in the lore of the item.
  • Moved bottles and alcoholic beverages to the Equipment category in the Creative Inventory.
  • Magic Resistance and Wither Ward now function correctly:
    • Magic Resistance now properly removes negative effects.
    • Wither Ward now properly removes the Wither effect.

New Settings Command

  • Added the new /rustic:settings command, allowing players to configure certain aspects of the addon. More configuration options will be added over time.
  • The command does not require cheats to be enabled and can only be used by administrators.
  • Currently, the only available option is Custom Effects UI, which is enabled by default.
  • This option controls the on-screen display of custom effects such as Magic Resistance, Wither Ward, Full Stomach, and Inebriation.
  • The setting is purely visual and was implemented to improve compatibility with addons that modify the player's HUD. Custom effects will continue to function normally when this option is disabled; however, players will no longer be able to see which custom effects are active or their current level.

General

  • Fixed an issue with the Crushing Tub where the Vanta Lily item was not rendered correctly inside the block.
  • Improved the connection system for Olive, Ironwood, and Applewood fences. These fences now use the minecraft:connection trait.
    • This change fixes several issues with fence connections. Previously, fences could connect to any block, including flowers, herbs, and even water. Connections are now handled instantly, removing the slight delay that occurred before fences connected.
  • Updated the textures of Iron and Gold Chandeliers.
  • Updated the chain texture used by Copper Chandeliers.
  • Increased the max stack size of Buckets to x8

Known Issues

  • There are still some blocks that fences should not connect to. These unintended connections will be addressed in future updates.

Changelog:

  • Added Caged Torches, a variant of regular torches that are resistant to flowing water. They can be crafted using 3 iron nuggets and any torch. (The caged redstone torch currently has a bug: it does not correctly detect signals from the block it is attached to. It can be obtained in Creative mode, but crafting will be unavailable until this is fixed.)
  • Reworked the Drying Basin: Now, evaporating one bottle of Wildberry Juice yields 3 Iron Dust. The Drying Basin no longer works in the Nether, as liquids evaporate instantly.
  • Updated textures for the following items: Chili Pepper, Poisonous Chili Pepper, Tomato, Poisonous Tomato, Beeswax, Tallow, Bee, Tiny Pile of Iron Dust, Cloudsbluff, Ginseng, Marshmallow, Drying Basin.
  • Slightly updated textures for the following items: Grapes, Poisonous Grapes, Ironberries, Olives, Iron Candles, Gold Candles, Copper Candles, Aloe Vera, Blood Orchid, Chamomile, Cohosh, Core Root, Horsetail, Vanta Lily, Wind Thistle.
  • Updated textures for the following blocks: Ironwood Log, Drying Basin, Iron Candles, Gold Candles, Copper Candles, Tomato and Chili Pepper on Wooden Stakes.
  • Changed the color of the entire Applewood set.
  • Breaking fertile farmland now drops fertile soil.
  • The gate's orientation when opening is more precise in the fence gates
  • Now the fence gates interact properly with redstone signals
  • Now the fence gates connect properly to the fences
  • Updated candles collision box (you can now walk over them without obstruction).
  • Adjusted the position of candle particles when lit.
  • Non-solid blocks (e.g., herbs, candles) no longer connect to fences.
  • Fixed a bug where items would drop when removing a rope from a wooden stake in Creative mode.
  • Fixed a bug that prevented grape seeds from being planted in fertile farmland.
  • Tomato and chili crops can now be harvested without breaking the wooden stake, dropping both seeds and crops.
  • Breaking a tomato or chili crop from its base now destroys the entire crop.
  • Adjusted the collision box of wooden stakes when connected by ropes.
  • Reduced the growth rate of tomato and chili crops.
  • Fixed a bug that prevented logs from being stripped.
  • Chili Pepper now plays a sound every time it is consumed.
  • Updated Ironberries effects:
    • No longer grant Fire Resistance when consumed.
    • Now apply Slowness III when consumed.
    • The inability to jump has been removed when consuming Ironberries.

Rustic Agriculture v2.2.0

Changelog:

  • The addon now use Script API V2.5.0
  • Added Vanta Oil, a new liquid that can be obtained by crushing Vanta Lilys in the Crushing Tub.
  • Optimized the geometry of the Crushing Tub and Liquid Barrel.
  • Added Ironwood, Apple Wood and Olive Buttons
  • You can now open doors with redstone (For now, there is a bug that prevents them from being closed with redstone. They only close with pressure plates.)
  • The visual geometry of trapdoors, fences and fence gates in inventories has been adjusted.
  • You can now attach mobs to fences (apple wood, ironwood and olive wood) with a lead.
  • The collision box and selection box for the wooden fences (apple wood, ironwood and olive wood) have been adjusted.
  • The collision box for stairs has been adjusted to match their base shape. They will now function like normal stairs. (The collision box does not cover all the shapes that stairs can have; this will be implemented in future updates when the stair connection system is compatible with multiplayer.)
  • The collision box of the crushing tub has been adjusted to fit the block model, which means that you can now step inside the crushing tub.
  • Now, in order to crush something in the crushing tub, you must jump inside the block, otherwise it will not work.
  • The system for detecting nearby water so that compost can be converted into fertile soil has been improved.
  • Fixed a bug that prevented using a hoe on fertile soil.
  • The identifier for fertile soil and fertile farmland has been changed. (This may cause bugs if these blocks are placed in the world; I recommend removing them before updating.)
  • Now when breaking fertile farmland, it will drop fertile soil.
  • The collision box for the wooden chairs have been adjusted.
  • The collision box for the vases have been adjusted.
  • The collision box and selection box for the wooden tables have been adjusted.
  • Now the wooden tables can get waterlogged.
  • The collision box for the beehive have been adjusted.
  • Fixed a bug that caused the wildberry bush to grow instantly when placed by a player. (This could be used to obtain infinite wildberries.)
  • Now all logs in the addon conduct redstone.
  • Now all painted planks conducts redstone.
  • Copper chains have been removed (they were recently added to the game).
  • Now the wooden lanterns can get waterlogged.

Known Issues:

  • The fences connect to any block (flowers, grass, etc.).

Changelog:

Crushing Tub:

Reworked: now uses an entity to display the items placed inside it.

  • The entity only appears if there are items inside.
  • This reduces the number of block state permutations, improving performance.
  • Also opens the possibility to add more recipes in future updates.
  • Items placed inside are now rendered in 3D instead of 2D.

Fixed bamboo crushing tub ID (it was written incorrectly).

  • ⚠️This will remove bamboo crushing tubs from existing worlds.
  • Recommended: break the block before updating to avoid loss.

Vases:

Updated the vase model. Changed the top texture. Vase recipe now yields 2 items instead of 3.

Crops & Plants:

Apples:

  • Harvesting from apple leaves now tries to place apples directly in the player’s inventory. If the inventory is full, they drop below the block.

Wildberries:

  • Fixed a bug where they disappeared if the inventory was full.
  • They now drop on the bush if the inventory is full.
  • Added a harvest sound when picking them.

Tomatoes & Chili Peppers:

  • Harvesting now collects the entire column at once. Herbs:
  • Are now separated from flowers in the creative inventory.

Items & Blocks

  • Compost, Fertile Soil, and Fertile Farmland now have their own item group in the creative inventory.
  • Grapes: eat duration increased from 1.2s → 1.5s.
  • Addon Slabs: in Creative mode, creating double slabs no longer consumes items.

Almanac

  • Adjusted the position and size when held in third-person view.
  • Now the book in your hand stays open while the Almanac UI is open, and closes when you exit.

Changelog:

  • The addon has been migrated to Script API V2.0.0
  • Fixed some bugs with texture references
  • Now the doors are only one item. You can select them in your hand with the pick block button.
  • Now the herbs are only one item. You can select them in your hand with the pick block button.
  • Now the leaves use alpha_test as render method.
  • Now the leaves have the same culling rules as vanilla leaves.
  • You can now change seats while sitting in a chair by interacting with another chair.
  • Now you can break the clay walls faster with any shovel.
  • Changed the sound of the sugar cane when interacting with the crushing tub.
  • Now if the crushing tub liquid level is full, you will not be able to crush any more items.
  • The model, selection box and tint color of the sugar cane planted in fertile soil now match the vanilla sugar cane.
  • The sugar cane planted in fertile soil now is compatible with texture packs.
  • The sugar cane planted in fertile soil now has the same interactions as vanilla sugar cane.
  • The image page of the almanac interface has been redesigned.
  • The size of the addon has been considerably reduced
  • Changed the recipe of the copper chains.

Changelog:

  • Now the leaves of the trees are tinted with the color of the biome they are in. (Ironwood, Olive)
  • Now the leaves of the wildberry bush are tinted with the color of the biome they are in.
  • Now the water in the liquid barrel and crushing tub matches the water color of the biome.
  • Now the textures of the compost, fertile soil and fertile farmland are isotropic.
  • Now the tree saplings use "place feature" for tree growing, this allows many variants of the trees.
  • Now the leaves of the trees will turn opaque in the far rendering.
  • Now apple trees do not use a structure and are generated randomly.
  • Fixed the sound when placing a double slab
  • Fixed a bug with stairs placement

Changelog:

  • When breaking a barrel with liquid inside, the item will now fall with the stored liquid allowing it to be placed in  another location without losing its contents.
  • The cabinet is shown in the chests item group again.
  • Fixed a bug that caused text to be displayed infinitely on the screen.
  • Fixed a bug that did not show the interface of any block.
  • Now you can obtain achievements with the addon.

Changelog:

  • Rustic planks and logs can be combined in recipes with the vanilla planks and logs.
  • Rustic planks, slabs and logs can be compatible in recipes from other addons as long as the recipe asks for the tag “minecraft:planks” or "minecraft:wooden_slabs" or "minecraft:logs".
  • Rustic planks, logs, woods, doors, stairs, slabs, fences and trapdoors can be used as fuel in furnaces.
  • Rustic logs and woods can be used to produce charcoal in furnaces.
  • Now, when using the "pick block" button on a candle, chain or rope, it will give you the item.
  • Fixed content errors of the iron lattice selection box and collision box.
  • The iron lattice now use only one block instead of two.
  • Improved the interaction with the iron lattice.
  • The following blocks can be waterlogged now: iron lattice, chains, chandelier, doors, slabs. stairs, fences, fence gates, leaves, trapdoors, ...
  • Now the water will break the herbs, wildberry bush and candles.
  • The interaction system of the chains has been improved.
  • Adjusted the geometry, selection and collision box of the chandeliers.
  • Now the arrows can destroy ropes. Destroying a rope that has a chandelier attached to it will cause it to fall.
  • Now, if a chandelier has candles attached to it, when the chandeliers falls the candles will also fall.
  • Now you can place doors underwater.
  • The interaction system of the leaves has been improved.
  • The recipe for wooden stakes now gives 3 instead of 1.
  • Removed bushes for chili pepper, grapes and tomato.
  • Herbs used to use 2 blocks to function, now they only use 1. (This change affects the generation in previously created worlds)
  • Added new herb, Vanta Lily. (Generates in soul sand valleys)
  • Vanta Lily can be placed on pots.
  • Wildberry bush can be used as fuel in furnaces (can smelt 1 item).
  • Improved the interaction system of the flower pot with the herbs.
  • Creative inventory organized with new item groups

Changelog:

 
  • Fixed a bug that prevented tomatoes and chili peppers from growing on vanilla farmland.
  • Fixed a bug with tomatoes being thrown towards an entity. It was constantly generating errors.
  • Added an interaction button with the almanac for mobile devices.
  • Grape seeds can now only be obtained by breaking vines. Tomato and chili pepper seeds are still obtained from short/tall grass.
  • The chances of obtaining seeds by breaking vines/grass were increased.
  • Now the blocks are broken at the correct speed with their appropriate tool.
  • Fixed minor bugs

Hotfix

Changelog:

  • Fixed a bug that prevented tomatoes and chili peppers from growing on vanilla farmland.
  • Fixed a bug with tomatoes being thrown towards an entity. It was constantly generating errors.
  • Added an interaction button with the almanac for mobile devices.
  • Grape seeds can now only be obtained by breaking vines. Tomato and chili pepper seeds are still obtained from short/tall grass.
  • The chances of obtaining seeds by breaking vines/grass were increased.

• Changes:
  • <mark class="marker-yellow">Added an interface to the Almanac, you can search for information about every feature in the addon (includes images).</mark>
  • Now when you break a beehive, the bee will get angry.
  • If a sapling seed is placed on farmland, the model will adjust the height of the block.
  • You can now collect berries from the wildberry bush directly in your inventory.
  • Chili peppers now have 33% chance of damage applied when consumed.
  • You can now place the wildberry bush in a flower pot.
  • Fixed some render issues of the flower pot with the herbs.
  • Added the ability to climb the ropes.
  • Now the Milk Bottle will remove 1 random effect instead of all effects.
  • Now you can waterlog ironwood, olive and apple wood slabs.
  • Added splashing sound to tomato when hitting an entity.
  • Hitting a player with a tomato will cause the player's camera to have the tomato splashed on it.
  • Hitting a block with a tomato will leave a stain.
  • Changed the texture of: Grapes, Poisonous Grapes.
  • Now you can put multiple items in the crushing tub at once. For example, if you have 8 wildberries and you interact while sneaking, 6 will be placed. If you have 4, 4 will be placed.
  • Now you can open the doors of the addon with a lever, pressure plates and buttons.
  • Now you can obtain grape seeds, tomato seeds and chili pepper seeds by breaking short grass and tall grass. (The probability of obtaining each seed is 5-7%, although you can find the some bushes of each crop in their respective biome)
  • Added ability to crush sugar cane in the crushing tub, produces water and 2 of sugar.
  • Now you can obtain 3 Iron dust with 1 bottle of ironberry juice in the drying basin.
  • Added functionality to the apiary, now you can store bees and farm honeycomb.
  • Now the leaves of the trees that generate in the world will fall if the log is broke.
  • A lot of bug fixes and improvements.
  • Mortar and pestle, olive seed flour, wheat flour removed. (I think it is better to keep the fidelity of the features of the original mod, maybe in the future they will come back in an additional addon that depends on this addon.)

data.short_description: Rustic is an addon that adds medieval-themed content in different areas: Agriculture, Production, and Decoration.
